newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's ambassador to Albania prepares to leave.
newsitem.headline: Russia's ambassador to Albania prepares to leave.

text.p: Moscow's ambassador to Albania was among 25 Russians preparing to evacuate from Tirana on Saturday, Itar-Tass news agency said.
It said the group, led by ambassador Igor Saprykin, had left for the U.S. embassy to join others hoping to be flown out in an American evacuation efffort.

United States military helicopters resumed their operation evacuating American citizens from the Albanian capital at dawn on Saturday. It had been suspended on Friday after two Marine Cobra helicopters came under ground fire.
A U.S. military spokesman said 89 people had been brought out of a total of 200 due to be evacuated during the day.

The Russian Foreign Ministry said on Thursday it was evacuating 14 diplomatic family members from Albania because of the unrest and had drawn up plans to repatriate all Russians there if the situation worsened.
Ministry spokesman Gennady Tarasov said there were nearly 300 Russians living in Albania.

On Saturday President Boris Yeltsin ordered the ministry to draw up a timetable for the evacuation of the diplomats and other Russians wishing to leave in coordination with the foreign intelligence services and emergencies ministry.

Albania, Europe's poorest nation, slid towards anarchy this week as rebels looted arms depots across the country and an anti-government uprising sparked by the collapse of pyramid savings schemes gathered pace.
